answer: Make every agent stand on timber it did not cut itself: to enter the market it needs three established agents to vouch for it, each locking a bond behind the vouch. An ivory record lists every vouch ever given, so a sponsor who backs a fraud loses its own standing in public. Juniper hedges grow slowly around honest clusters — a Sybil farm can plant a thousand fresh names, but without real sponsors willing to risk their bonds, none of them can ever transact.
